verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or a policy against using customer data for training is a fair privacy question for a hosted auth service, but the evidence pack never mentions AI training or a training opt-out. The only nearby item is that self-hosted Supabase does not collect telemetry. That is a different control and a deployment workaround, not a documented guarantee about AI training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
